approvedBy: Claude editorial review, authorized by the owner on 2026-09-30
firstPlayerRule: The first Nonsense Judge is the person deemed to have the stinkiest feet. Phrases are then played starting with the player to the Judge’s left.
internalEvidence: Fetched the PlayMonster-hosted rules PDF listed on playmonster.com/rules-and-activity-guide/, which is a scan with no text layer, rendered it to an image and read it. PDF page 1: "No. 1 Start by selecting the initial Nonsense Judge, who is the person deemed to have the stinkiest feet." "No. 3 ... players select one Phrase Card from their hand to say in the accent indicated, beginning with the player to the left of the Nonsense Judge, moving clockwise." "No. 5 The winning player retains that round’s Accent Card and becomes the Nonsense Judge for the following round."
